# Install prompt

Paste everything below the line into Claude Code on the machine where you want pipeline-lite.
It is self-contained: every file of the plugin is embedded below, so nothing is downloaded.
Claude writes the files, runs the installer and asks you only for the kb location and which projects to register.

<!-- Generated by scripts/build_install_prompt.py; do not edit by hand. -->

---

Install the "pipeline-lite" Claude Code plugin (version 0.1.0, content id `21604d1b6ac6`) for my user-level Claude Code setup. Every file it needs is embedded at the end of this message, so don't clone or download anything. Do the steps below in order. Look before you change anything, and don't overwrite or delete existing files without asking me.

1. **Check the prerequisites.** Confirm that `claude`, `python3` and `git` are on PATH (the installer uses git for the local kb), and say whether `rg` is there (optional search fallback). If a required tool is missing, stop and tell me how to install it. This setup expects Linux or macOS with bash. On Windows, stop and tell me it needs WSL.

2. **Check the target directory.** The files go into `~/pipeline-lite`. If it doesn't exist, create it. If it exists, compare it with the manifest in step 4 and show me which files would change and which extra files are there. Ask before overwriting anything. Never delete files that aren't in the manifest.

3. **Write the files.** Write every file from the "Files" section below into `~/pipeline-lite`, at the path in its heading, byte for byte. The content is everything between the `~~~~~` fence lines, ending with exactly one newline. Don't reformat, fix or shorten anything, even if it looks wrong. The safest way is a quoted heredoc per file, which keeps `$`, backticks and backslashes as they are:

   ```bash
   mkdir -p ~/pipeline-lite/kb/kb
   cat > ~/pipeline-lite/kb/kb/__init__.py <<'__PIPELINE_LITE_EOF__'
   <content>
   __PIPELINE_LITE_EOF__
   ```

   Several files per command is fine. Empty files are marked as such; create them with `: > <path>`. Then run `chmod +x` on every file marked executable.

   If I gave you this prompt as a file path instead of pasting it, extract the files mechanically instead of writing them by hand:

   ```bash
   python3 - <prompt-file> ~/pipeline-lite <<'PY'
   import os, re, sys
   text = open(sys.argv[1], encoding="utf-8").read()
   dest = os.path.expanduser(sys.argv[2])
   part = text.split("\n## Files\n", 1)[1]
   for m in re.finditer(r"^### `([^`]+)`([^\n]*)\n~~~~~\n(.*?)^~~~~~$", part, re.S | re.M):
       path = os.path.join(dest, m.group(1))
       os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(path), exist_ok=True)
       with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8", newline="") as f:
           f.write(m.group(3))
       if "executable" in m.group(2):
           os.chmod(path, 0o755)
   PY
   ```

4. **Verify the files.** Save the lines of the "Manifest" section below as `~/pipeline-lite/.manifest.sha256` and run `cd ~/pipeline-lite && sha256sum -c .manifest.sha256` (on macOS `shasum -a 256 -c .manifest.sha256`). Rewrite every file that fails and check again. Don't continue until all 22 files pass.

5. **Choose the knowledge base location.** The kb is a local-only git repo of markdown notes. The default is `~/agent-kb`, or `$KB_DIR` if that is set. Ask me whether the default is fine. If I pick another path, `KB_DIR` has to be set for the hooks too: offer to add it to the `env` block of `~/.claude/settings.json` and to my shell profile. Don't change either file without my yes.

6. **Preview the install.** Run `~/pipeline-lite/install.sh --dry-run` (add `--kb <path>` if I chose one) and show me the output. Point out anything that will be backed up, such as an existing `~/.local/bin/kb`. If the installer warns that the marketplace `agentic-pipeline-lite` is already registered from a different path, stop and show me the warning. Don't remove the old registration yourself.

7. **Install.** After I confirm, run the same command without `--dry-run`. The installer registers `~/pipeline-lite` as the local marketplace `agentic-pipeline-lite`, installs and enables `pipeline@agentic-pipeline-lite` at user scope, symlinks `bin/kb` into `~/.local/bin`, and creates the kb if it doesn't exist (git init, no remote, a `pre-push` hook that refuses every push). Re-running it is safe.

8. **Check PATH.** If `~/.local/bin` isn't on my PATH, tell me the one line to add to my shell profile and offer to add it. The hooks still work without it, but I won't be able to run `kb` myself.

9. **Register projects.** A project card is what makes a new session start with that project's context. Ask me which repos I want cards for, suggesting the git repo of the current directory if there is one. For each repo I pick, read its README and build files to propose a stack and the test/build commands, show me the proposal, and then run `kb project add <name> --path <dir> --stack "<stack>" --commands "<cmd>"` (one `--commands` per command). I can add more later the same way.

10. **Verify and report.** Confirm that `claude plugin list` shows `pipeline@agentic-pipeline-lite` as enabled, that `kb check` passes and that `kb project list` shows the cards. Then tell me in a few lines what you did, what you skipped and that I need to restart Claude Code. After the restart, sessions start with the project card and journal, and the skills appear as `/pipeline:kb`, `/pipeline:retro` and `/pipeline:status`. To update later, paste a newer version of this prompt. To uninstall, run `~/pipeline-lite/install.sh --uninstall`, which never deletes the kb.

It pairs with the lead workflow (https://github.com/hawt-cid/lead-workflow), whose task handoffs the session-start hook reads. If the `lead` skill isn't installed, mention that in one line, but don't install it.

Don't commit or push anything, and don't change any project repo. Never add a remote to the kb or send its contents to an external service. This install touches only `~/pipeline-lite`, the kb, `~/.local/bin/kb` and the Claude Code plugin registry, plus `~/.claude/settings.json` and my shell profile if I agreed to it in step 5 or 8.

### `README.md`
~~~~~
# pipeline-lite

A personal agent setup for Claude Code that works across projects:

- **Continuity**: each new session starts with the project card, open work and last handoff, so you don't re-explain.
- **Persistence**: knowledge lives as plain markdown in a separate, local-only git repo (default `~/agent-kb`).
- **Journal**: every session leaves a short entry (changed files, commits, summary, friction).
- **Self-improvement**: `/pipeline:retro` turns the journal into *proposed* instruction edits; nothing changes without approval.
- **Backlog**: `kb backlog` lists open tasks and ideas across all registered projects.

It pairs with the [lead workflow](https://github.com/hawt-cid/lead-workflow): the session-start hook reads the Handoff from the Lead's `.tasks/<slug>/TASK.md`. It also works without it.

Status: in use. A dogfood week on a real project is running; expect small changes from its retro.

## Install

Requires `claude`, `git` and `python3` (stdlib only; `rg` is an optional search fallback).

Quickest: paste [`INSTALL-PROMPT.md`](INSTALL-PROMPT.md) into Claude Code. It is self-contained (every file is embedded with a sha256 manifest), so nothing is cloned or downloaded; Claude writes the files to `~/pipeline-lite`, runs the installer and helps register your first projects. You can also install by hand:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hawt-cid/pipeline-lite ~/pipeline-lite
cd ~/pipeline-lite && ./install.sh     # optional: --kb /path/to/kb, --dry-run to preview
```

This registers the repo as the local marketplace `agentic-pipeline-lite`, installs and enables `pipeline@agentic-pipeline-lite` (user scope), symlinks `bin/*` into `~/.local/bin`, and creates the knowledge base at `${KB_DIR:-~/agent-kb}` from `kb-template/` if it does not exist. The kb is **local only**: no git remote and a `pre-push` hook that refuses every push. Existing files at link targets are moved to `<path>.bak.<timestamp>`; re-running changes nothing.

The plugin is read live from `plugin/` in this checkout, so `git pull` updates it. Changes take effect at the next session start or `/reload-plugins`. Switching branches in this checkout changes the hooks of every session.

Then register each project you want a card for:

```bash
kb project add <name> --path ~/work/repo --stack "python, postgres" --commands "make test"
```

## How a session works

| Hook | What it does |
|---|---|
| SessionStart | Injects the project card for the cwd, open `.tasks/*/TASK.md` handoffs (full one for the task on the current branch) and the last 5 journal entries; ≤ 8k chars. A git repo without a card gets a one-line `kb project add` hint. |
| Stop | Counts turns and keeps the last reply (≤ 500 chars) in a session state file. Never reads the transcript. |
| SessionEnd | Appends a journal entry to `<kb>/journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md`: cwd, reason, turns, duration, changed files, commits, summary, friction. No LLM, no commit. |

When you correct Claude or a tool fails, Claude logs it with `kb journal friction "<text>"`; you can too. `kb journal tail [--project P] [-n N]` shows recent entries.

The journal stores file paths, commit subjects and short summaries. It stays on your machine, but keep that in mind for work repos.

## Retro

Run `/pipeline:retro` every few days. It reads the journal and friction since the last retro (`kb retro gather`) and writes up to 5 proposals to `<kb>/inbox/retro-<date>.md`. Each one is a small edit to `CLAUDE.md`, memory or a skill, backed by at least two journal occurrences or one explicit correction. You accept or reject each one; only accepted ones are applied. `kb retro record` saves the outcome and commits the journal locally.

## Backlog and ideas

```bash
kb backlog [--project P] [--all]       # open tasks, their next step, ideas per project, inbox count
kb idea add "<text>" [--project P] [--tags a,b]   # default project = card for the cwd
kb idea done <id>
```

## kb

`bin/kb` is a stdlib-only Python CLI (package in `kb/`) over the knowledge base. Location: `--kb PATH` > `$KB_DIR` > `~/agent-kb`. The kb is local only; never push it or send its contents to external services.

```bash
kb new <type> <title> [--id ID] [--project NAME] [--tags a,b] [--refs a,b] [--body TEXT | --body -]
kb read <id> [--refs]                  # --refs: referenced notes (one level) + backlinks
kb search <query> [--type T] [--project P] [--limit N]
kb link <from> <to>                    # add a ref, idempotent
kb check                               # frontmatter, required fields, types, ids, duplicates, dangling refs
kb index                               # force an index rebuild
kb project add <name> --path DIR [--stack S] [--commands CMD ...] [--status active|paused|done]
kb project list
kb project find [--path DIR]           # card for DIR or its closest ancestor; exit 1 if none
```

`read`, `search`, `project list` and `project find` accept `--json`. `--commands` is repeatable (one command each). `proj://<name>` means id `proj-<name>` and `kb://<id>` means `<id>`; both work wherever an id is taken.

**Notes** are `notes/<id>.md`: frontmatter between `---` lines, then a markdown body. Types: `note`, `project`, `idea`, `decision`, `howto`, `retro`. Fields: `id, type, title, project, tags, refs, status, created, updated`; project cards also `path, stack, commands`. Frontmatter is a restricted YAML subset: `key: value` scalars (double-quoted JSON strings when escaping is needed), inline lists `[a, b]`, and `commands` written as a `- item` block list (an inline list is accepted too). References are the `refs` field plus `[[id]]` links in the body.

Search uses a SQLite FTS5 index at `<kb>/.index/kb.sqlite` (git-ignored), rebuilt automatically when any note file changes. Without FTS5 (or with `KB_NO_FTS=1`) it falls back to ripgrep with the same output. The plugin skill `kb` teaches Claude when to read and write.

## Tests

```bash
python3 -m unittest discover -s tests
bash tests/install_test.sh
claude plugin validate plugin && claude plugin validate .
```

`INSTALL-PROMPT.md` is generated: after changing any shipped file, run `scripts/build_install_prompt.py`. A test fails while it is stale.

## Uninstall

```bash
./install.sh --uninstall
```

Removes the plugin, the marketplace registration and only the symlinks that point into this repo. The kb is never deleted; its location is printed.

# Entrypoint for the kb CLI: resolves its real path (it is symlinked into
# ~/.local/bin) and runs the stdlib-only Python package in kb/.

### `install.sh` · executable
~~~~~
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Installer for agentic-pipeline-lite.
# Registers this repo as a local Claude Code marketplace, installs the
# `pipeline` plugin, links bin/* into ~/.local/bin and creates a local-only kb.
set -euo pipefail

MARKETPLACE="agentic-pipeline-lite"
PLUGIN="pipeline@${MARKETPLACE}"

REPO="$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
KB="${KB_DIR:-$HOME/agent-kb}"
LINK_DIR="$HOME/.local/bin"
DRY_RUN=0
UNINSTALL=0
CHANGES=0

usage() {
  cat <<EOF
Usage: install.sh [--kb <path>] [--dry-run] [--uninstall] [--help]

Installs the agentic-pipeline-lite setup:
  - registers this repo as the local marketplace '${MARKETPLACE}'
    and installs + enables '${PLUGIN}' at user scope
  - symlinks every bin/* into ~/.local/bin
  - creates the knowledge base from kb-template/ if absent
    (default \$HOME/agent-kb, or \$KB_DIR, or --kb <path>); local only, no remote

Options:
  --kb <path>   knowledge base location
  --dry-run     print every action, change nothing
  --uninstall   remove plugin, marketplace and symlinks into this repo;
                the kb is never deleted
  --help        show this help

Existing files at link targets are moved to <path>.bak.<timestamp>.
Re-running is a no-op when everything is already in place.
EOF
}

while [ $# -gt 0 ]; do
  case "$1" in
    --kb)
      [ $# -ge 2 ] || { echo "install.sh: --kb needs a path" >&2; exit 2; }
      KB="$2"; shift 2 ;;
    --dry-run) DRY_RUN=1; shift ;;
    --uninstall) UNINSTALL=1; shift ;;
    --help|-h) usage; exit 0 ;;
    *) echo "install.sh: unknown option: $1" >&2; usage >&2; exit 2 ;;
  esac
done

for tool in claude git python3; do
  command -v "$tool" >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "install.sh: required tool '$tool' not found in PATH" >&2; exit 1; }
done

say() { printf '%s\n' "$*"; }

# act <description> <command...>: print, and run unless --dry-run.
act() {
  local desc="$1"; shift
  CHANGES=$((CHANGES + 1))
  if [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
    say "[dry-run] $desc"
  else
    say "$desc"
    "$@"
  fi
}

# Prints the path of our registered marketplace; exit 1 if not registered.
marketplace_path() {
  claude plugin marketplace list --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c '
import json, sys
for m in json.load(sys.stdin):
    if m.get("name") == sys.argv[1]:
        print(m.get("path") or m.get("installLocation") or "")
        sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)' "$MARKETPLACE"
}

# Prints "enabled" or "disabled" for our plugin; exit 1 if not installed.
plugin_state() {
  claude plugin list --json 2>/dev/null | python3 -c '
import json, sys
for p in json.load(sys.stdin):
    if p.get("id") == sys.argv[1]:
        print("enabled" if p.get("enabled") else "disabled")
        sys.exit(0)
sys.exit(1)' "$PLUGIN"
}

# Sets MP_STATE to none|ours|other and MP_PATH to the registered path.
check_marketplace() {
  MP_PATH=""
  if MP_PATH="$(marketplace_path)"; then
    if [ "$(readlink -m "$MP_PATH")" = "$REPO" ]; then MP_STATE=ours; else MP_STATE=other; fi
  else
    MP_STATE=none
  fi
}

warn_other_marketplace() {
  cat >&2 <<MSG
WARNING: marketplace '${MARKETPLACE}' is already registered from a different path:
  registered: ${MP_PATH}
  this repo:  ${REPO}
Nothing was changed for the plugin or marketplace. To switch, run
'./install.sh --uninstall' from the old checkout (${MP_PATH}),
or 'claude plugin marketplace remove ${MARKETPLACE}', then re-run this installer.
MSG
}

# True if $1 is a symlink whose target lies inside this repo.
links_into_repo() {
  [ -L "$1" ] || return 1
  case "$(readlink -m "$1")" in
    "$REPO"/*) return 0 ;;
    *) return 1 ;;
  esac
}

backup() {
  local path="$1" dest
  dest="${path}.bak.$(date +%Y%m%d%H%M%S)"
  mv "$path" "$dest"
}

install_kb() {
  cp -R "$REPO/kb-template" "$KB"
  git -C "$KB" init -q
  cat > "$KB/.git/hooks/pre-push" <<'HOOK'
#!/bin/sh
echo "pre-push: this knowledge base is LOCAL ONLY and must never be pushed." >&2
exit 1
HOOK
  chmod +x "$KB/.git/hooks/pre-push"
  git -C "$KB" add -A
  git -C "$KB" -c user.name="agent-kb" -c user.email="agent-kb@localhost" \
    -c commit.gpgsign=false commit -q -m "chore: initialize knowledge base"
}

do_install() {
  # 1. marketplace
  check_marketplace
  case "$MP_STATE" in
    other) warn_other_marketplace; exit 1 ;;
    ours) say "ok: marketplace ${MARKETPLACE} already registered" ;;
    none) act "register marketplace ${MARKETPLACE} (${REPO})" claude plugin marketplace add "$REPO" ;;
  esac

  # 2. plugin (the installed plugin is read live from plugin/, see README)
  local state=""
  state="$(plugin_state)" || state=""
  case "$state" in
    enabled) say "ok: plugin ${PLUGIN} already installed and enabled" ;;
    disabled) act "enable plugin ${PLUGIN}" claude plugin enable "$PLUGIN" --scope user ;;
    *) act "install plugin ${PLUGIN} (user scope)" claude plugin install "$PLUGIN" --scope user ;;
  esac

  # 3. links
  if [ ! -d "$LINK_DIR" ]; then
    act "create ${LINK_DIR}" mkdir -p "$LINK_DIR"
  fi
  local src name target
  for src in "$REPO"/bin/*; do
    [ -e "$src" ] || continue
    name="$(basename "$src")"
    target="$LINK_DIR/$name"
    if links_into_repo "$target"; then
      say "ok: ${target} already links into this repo"
      continue
    fi
    if [ -e "$target" ] || [ -L "$target" ]; then
      act "back up existing ${target} to ${target}.bak.<timestamp>" backup "$target"
    fi
    act "link ${target} -> ${src}" ln -s "$src" "$target"
  done

  # 4. kb
  if [ -e "$KB" ]; then
    say "ok: kb exists at ${KB} (left alone)"
  else
    act "create local-only kb at ${KB} (git init, no remote, pre-push blocked)" install_kb
  fi

  if [ "$CHANGES" -eq 0 ]; then
    say "Nothing to do: already installed."
  elif [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
    say "Dry run: ${CHANGES} change(s) would be made."
  else
    say "Done: ${CHANGES} change(s) made. Restart Claude Code sessions to load the plugin."
  fi
}

do_uninstall() {
  check_marketplace
  case "$MP_STATE" in
    other)
      warn_other_marketplace
      say "skipped plugin and marketplace removal (registered from another path)" ;;
    ours)
      if plugin_state >/dev/null; then
        act "uninstall plugin ${PLUGIN}" claude plugin uninstall "$PLUGIN" --scope user
      else
        say "ok: plugin ${PLUGIN} not installed"
      fi
      act "remove marketplace ${MARKETPLACE}" claude plugin marketplace remove "$MARKETPLACE" ;;
    none)
      say "ok: plugin ${PLUGIN} and marketplace ${MARKETPLACE} not registered" ;;
  esac

  local src name target
  for src in "$REPO"/bin/*; do
    [ -e "$src" ] || continue
    name="$(basename "$src")"
    target="$LINK_DIR/$name"
    if links_into_repo "$target"; then
      act "remove link ${target}" rm -f "$target"
    fi
  done

  say "kb NOT deleted; it stays at ${KB}"
  if [ "$CHANGES" -eq 0 ]; then
    say "Nothing to do: already uninstalled."
  elif [ "$DRY_RUN" -eq 1 ]; then
    say "Dry run: ${CHANGES} change(s) would be made."
  else
    say "Done: ${CHANGES} change(s) made."
  fi
}

if [ "$UNINSTALL" -eq 1 ]; then
  do_uninstall
else
  do_install
fi

# agent-kb

Personal knowledge base for the agentic-pipeline-lite setup: plain markdown notes, session journals and an inbox for captured items.

- `notes/` curated knowledge
- `journal/` session journals
- `inbox/` raw captures awaiting review

Notes are `notes/<id>.md` with `---` delimited frontmatter (`id, type, title, project, tags, refs, status, created, updated`; project cards add `path, stack, commands`) and a markdown body. Use the `kb` CLI to create and search them; `kb check` validates. See the repo README for details.

**LOCAL ONLY. Never push this repo anywhere.** It may contain sensitive data. It has no git remote and a `pre-push` hook that refuses every push; do not remove either.

"""Command line interface: python3 -m kb <command> (normally via bin/kb)."""
import argparse
import json
import os
import sys

from . import backlog, hooks, retro
from .store import STATUSES, TYPES, Kb, KbError, find_kb, resolve_id, today


def csv(s):
    return [x.strip() for x in s.split(",") if x.strip()] if s else []


def emit(obj):
    print(json.dumps(obj, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False))


def card_line(n):
    return f"{n.id}  {n.get('status') or '-'}  {n.get('path') or '-'}"


def cmd_new(kb, a):
    body = sys.stdin.read() if a.body == "-" else (a.body or "")
    extra = {"path": os.path.abspath(os.path.expanduser(a.path)) if a.path else "",
             "stack": a.stack, "commands": a.commands or [], "status": a.status}
    n = kb.create(a.type, a.title, a.id, a.project or "", csv(a.tags), csv(a.refs), body, extra)
    print(f"{n.id}\n{n.path}")


def cmd_read(kb, a):
    note = kb.get(a.id)
    refs, back = [], []
    if a.refs:
        for r in note.refs():
            try:
                refs.append(kb.get(r))
            except KbError:
                refs.append(r)  # dangling: keep the bare id
        back = kb.backlinks(note.id)
    if a.json:
        emit({"note": note.to_dict(),
              "refs": [r.to_dict() if not isinstance(r, str) else {"id": r, "missing": True} for r in refs],
              "backlinks": [{"id": b.id, "title": b.get("title")} for b in back]})
        return
    print(note.text(), end="")
    if a.refs:
        for r in refs:
            print(f"\n=== ref: {r if isinstance(r, str) else r.id} ===")
            print("(missing)" if isinstance(r, str) else r.text(), end="" if not isinstance(r, str) else "\n")
        print("\n=== backlinks ===")
        print("\n".join(f"{b.id}  {b.get('title')}" for b in back) or "(none)")


def cmd_search(kb, a):
    hits = kb.search(" ".join(a.query), a.type, a.project, a.limit)
    if a.json:
        return emit(hits)
    for h in hits:
        print(f"{h['id']}  [{h['type']}]  {h['title']}")
        if h["snippet"]:
            print(f"    {h['snippet']}")


def cmd_link(kb, a):
    src, dst = kb.get(a.src), kb.get(a.dst)
    refs = src.meta.setdefault("refs", [])
    if dst.id in refs:
        print(f"already linked: {src.id} -> {dst.id}")
        return
    refs.append(dst.id)
    src.meta["updated"] = today()
    kb.save(src)
    print(f"linked: {src.id} -> {dst.id}")


def cmd_check(kb, a):
    problems, count = kb.check()
    for p in problems:
        print(p)
    if problems:
        print(f"{len(problems)} problem(s) in {count} parsed note(s)", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    print(f"OK: {count} note(s)")


def cmd_index(kb, a):
    kb.index(force=True).close()
    print(f"index rebuilt: {kb.root / '.index' / 'kb.sqlite'}")


def cmd_project(kb, a):
    if a.pcmd == "add":
        a.type, a.title, a.id, a.tags, a.refs, a.body = "project", a.name, None, "", "", ""
        a.project = None
        return cmd_new(kb, a)
    if a.pcmd == "list":
        cards = sorted(kb.projects(), key=lambda n: n.id)
        if a.json:
            return emit([n.to_dict() for n in cards])
        for n in cards:
            print(card_line(n))
        return
    card = kb.find_project(a.path or os.getcwd())
    if card is None:
        print(f"no project card for {a.path or os.getcwd()}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    if a.json:
        return emit(card.to_dict())
    print(card.text(), end="")


def cmd_journal(kb, a):
    if a.jcmd == "friction":
        print(hooks.add_friction(kb.root, " ".join(a.text), os.getcwd()))
        return
    for e in hooks.tail(kb.root, a.project, a.n):
        print(e + "\n")


def cmd_retro(kb, a):
    if a.rcmd == "gather":
        g = retro.gather(kb, a.since, a.project)
        return emit(retro.to_json(g)) if a.json else print(retro.render(g), end="")
    if a.body == "-":
        body = sys.stdin.read()
    elif a.body_file:
        try:
            body = open(os.path.expanduser(a.body_file), encoding="utf-8").read()
        except OSError as e:
            raise KbError(f"cannot read body file: {e}")
    else:
        body = ""
    note, status = retro.record(kb, a.until, csv(a.accepted), csv(a.rejected), body)
    print(f"{note.id}\n{note.path}\n{status}")


def cmd_backlog(kb, a):
    g = backlog.gather(kb, a.project, a.all)
    return emit(g) if a.json else print(backlog.render(g), end="")


def cmd_idea(kb, a):
    if a.icmd == "add":
        print(backlog.idea_add(kb, a.text, a.project, csv(a.tags)).id)
    else:
        print(f"done: {backlog.idea_done(kb, a.id).id}")


def build_parser():
    def common_opts(**kw):  # fresh actions each time: set_defaults would leak into shared ones
        c = argparse.ArgumentParser(add_help=False)
        c.add_argument("--kb", metavar="PATH", help="kb directory (default: $KB_DIR or ~/agent-kb)", **kw)
        c.add_argument("--json", action="store_true", help="JSON output (read, search, project list/find)", **kw)
        return c

    common = common_opts(default=argparse.SUPPRESS)
    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="kb", description="Markdown knowledge store and project registry.",
                                parents=[common_opts()])
    sub = p.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True)

    def add(name, fn, help_, **kw):
        sp = sub.add_parser(name, help=help_, parents=[common], **kw)
        sp.set_defaults(fn=fn)
        return sp

    def card_opts(sp):
        sp.add_argument("--stack", default="", help="e.g. 'python, sqlite'")
        sp.add_argument("--commands", action="append", help="a useful command (repeat for several)")
        sp.add_argument("--status", help="active|paused|done")

    s = add("new", cmd_new, "create a note")
    s.add_argument("type", choices=TYPES)
    s.add_argument("title")
    s.add_argument("--id")
    s.add_argument("--project")
    s.add_argument("--tags", help="comma separated")
    s.add_argument("--refs", help="comma separated ids")
    s.add_argument("--body", help="body text, or - for stdin")
    s.add_argument("--path", help="project notes: directory of the project")
    card_opts(s)

    s = add("read", cmd_read, "print a note")
    s.add_argument("id")
    s.add_argument("--refs", action="store_true", help="also print referenced notes and backlinks")

    s = add("search", cmd_search, "full-text search")
    s.add_argument("query", nargs="+")
    s.add_argument("--type", choices=TYPES)
    s.add_argument("--project")
    s.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=10)

    s = add("link", cmd_link, "add a ref from one note to another")
    s.add_argument("src", metavar="from")
    s.add_argument("dst", metavar="to")

    add("check", cmd_check, "validate all notes")
    add("index", cmd_index, "force a search index rebuild")

    s = add("project", cmd_project, "project registry")
    ps = s.add_subparsers(dest="pcmd", required=True)
    a = ps.add_parser("add", parents=[common], help="register a project")
    a.add_argument("name")
    a.add_argument("--path", required=True)
    card_opts(a)
    ps.add_parser("list", parents=[common], help="list project cards")
    f = ps.add_parser("find", parents=[common], help="card for a directory (default: cwd); exit 1 if none")
    f.add_argument("--path")
    s = add("journal", cmd_journal, "session journal (local only)")
    js = s.add_subparsers(dest="jcmd", required=True)
    f = js.add_parser("friction", parents=[common],
                      help="log a friction note: attaches to the newest live session whose cwd equals, "
                           "contains or is inside the current dir; else a standalone journal line")
    f.add_argument("text", nargs="+")
    t = js.add_parser("tail", parents=[common], help="print the last N journal entries (newest last)")
    t.add_argument("--project")
    t.add_argument("-n", type=int, default=5)

    s = add("retro", cmd_retro, "self-improvement loop: journal digest and retro log")
    rs = s.add_subparsers(dest="rcmd", required=True)
    g = rs.add_parser("gather", parents=[common],
                      help="journal entries + friction since the last retro, and instruction files in scope")
    g.add_argument("--since", metavar="ISO", help="override the start (default: newest retro note's until)")
    g.add_argument("--project", help="only this project label (card id)")
    r = rs.add_parser("record", parents=[common], help="write notes/retro-<date>.md and commit journal + note locally")
    r.add_argument("--until", required=True, metavar="ISO", help="the gather timestamp: the next gather starts here")
    r.add_argument("--accepted", help="comma separated")
    r.add_argument("--rejected", help="comma separated")
    bg = r.add_mutually_exclusive_group()
    bg.add_argument("--body-file", metavar="F")
    bg.add_argument("--body", help="- for stdin")

    s = add("backlog", cmd_backlog, "open tasks and ideas across registered projects, plus the inbox")
    s.add_argument("--project", help="only this project (name, proj://name or card id)")
    s.add_argument("--all", action="store_true", help="include done/parked tasks, done ideas and done projects")

    s = add("idea", cmd_idea, "capture ideas: idea add|done")
    isub = s.add_subparsers(dest="icmd", required=True)
    f = isub.add_parser("add", parents=[common], help="new idea; default project = card for the cwd")
    f.add_argument("text")
    f.add_argument("--project")
    f.add_argument("--tags", help="comma separated")
    f = isub.add_parser("done", parents=[common], help="mark an idea done")
    f.add_argument("id")

    s = add("hook", None, "session lifecycle hook handler (stdin = hook JSON; always exits 0)")
    s.add_argument("event", choices=hooks.EVENTS)
    return p


def main(argv=None):
    a = build_parser().parse_args(argv)
    if a.cmd == "hook":
        return hooks.run(a.event, a.kb)
    try:
        if a.cmd == "project" and a.pcmd == "add" and a.status and a.status not in STATUSES:
            raise KbError(f"status must be one of: {', '.join(STATUSES)}")
        return getattr(a, "fn")(Kb(find_kb(a.kb)), a) or 0
    except KbError as e:
        print(f"kb: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
        return 1
    except BrokenPipeError:
        return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())

### `kb/kb/backlog.py`
~~~~~
"""Cross-project backlog: open tasks (from TASK.md files), open ideas and the inbox.

Read-only: only `git worktree list` is run, nothing is written outside the kb.
"""
import os

from .hooks import main_worktree, parse_tasks
from .store import KbError, resolve_id, slugify, today

NEXT_CAP = 200


def match_card(cards, raw):
    ref = resolve_id(raw)
    for c in cards:
        if ref in (c.id, "proj-" + ref, c.get("project")) or slugify(ref) == c.get("project"):
            return c
    return None


def ideas(kb):
    out = []
    for p in kb.files():
        try:
            if "type: idea" not in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")[:2000]:
                continue
            n = kb.load_file(p)
        except (KbError, OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            continue
        if n.get("type") == "idea":
            out.append(n)
    return sorted(out, key=lambda n: n.id)


def idea_dict(n):
    return {"id": n.id, "title": n.get("title"), "status": n.get("status") or "active"}


def task_dict(t):
    open_ = [name for name, st in t["steps"] if st != "done"]
    nxt = t["next"]
    return {"title": t["title"], "status": t["status"], "branch": t["branch"],
            "next_step": open_[0] if open_ else "", "open_steps": len(open_),
            "next": nxt if len(nxt) <= NEXT_CAP else nxt[:NEXT_CAP - 3] + "..."}


def gather(kb, project=None, all_=False):
    allcards = sorted(kb.projects(), key=lambda n: n.id)
    cards = allcards
    if project:
        c = match_card(allcards, project)
        if c is None:
            raise KbError(f"no project card for '{project}'")
        cards = [c]
    notes = [n for n in ideas(kb) if all_ or n.get("status") != "done"]
    res = {"projects": [], "unfiled": [], "warnings": [], "inbox": {"count": 0, "files": []}}
    for c in cards:
        if not all_ and c.get("status") == "done":
            continue
        raw = c.get("path")
        path = os.path.expanduser(raw) if raw else ""
        if not path or not os.path.isdir(path):
            res["warnings"].append(f"{c.id}: path missing ({raw or 'not set'})")
            continue
        root = main_worktree(path) or path
        tasks = [task_dict(t) for t in parse_tasks(root, all_)]
        mine = [idea_dict(n) for n in notes if n.get("project") and match_card([c], n.get("project")) is c]
        if tasks or mine:
            res["projects"].append({"id": c.id, "path": raw, "tasks": tasks, "ideas": mine})
    if not project:
        res["unfiled"] = [idea_dict(n) for n in notes
                          if not n.get("project") or match_card(allcards, n.get("project")) is None]
    inbox = kb.root / "inbox"
    files = sorted(f.name for f in inbox.iterdir() if f.is_file() and not f.name.startswith(".")) if inbox.is_dir() else []
    res["inbox"] = {"count": len(files), "files": files}
    return res


def idea_line(i):
    return f"  idea: {i['id']}  {i['title']}" + ("  [done]" if i["status"] == "done" else "")


def render(g):
    out = [f"warning: {w}" for w in g["warnings"]]
    for p in g["projects"]:
        out.append(f"{p['id']}  {p['path']}")
        for t in p["tasks"]:
            out.append(f"  task: {t['title']}  [{t['status']}]" + (f"  {t['branch']}" if t["branch"] else ""))
            if t["next_step"]:
                out.append(f"    step: {t['next_step']}  ({t['open_steps']} open)")
            if t["next"]:
                out.append(f"    next: {t['next']}")
        out += [idea_line(i) for i in p["ideas"]]
    if g["unfiled"]:
        out.append("unfiled")
        out += [idea_line(i) for i in g["unfiled"]]
    ib = g["inbox"]
    out.append(f"inbox: {ib['count']}" + (f"  {', '.join(ib['files'])}" if ib["files"] else ""))
    return "\n".join(out) + "\n"


def idea_add(kb, text, project=None, tags=(), cwd=None):
    text = text.strip()
    if not text:
        raise KbError("idea text is empty")
    title = " ".join(text.split("\n", 1)[0].split())[:60].strip()
    if project:
        c = match_card(kb.projects(), project)
        pid = c.id if c else resolve_id(project)
    else:
        c = kb.find_project(cwd or os.getcwd())
        pid = c.id if c else ""
    base, n = slugify(title), 1
    while True:
        try:
            return kb.create("idea", title, base if n == 1 else f"{base}-{n}", pid, tags, (), text,
                             {"status": "active"})
        except KbError as e:
            if "already exists" not in str(e) or n > 50:
                raise
            n += 1


def idea_done(kb, raw_id):
    n = kb.get(raw_id)
    if n.get("type") != "idea":
        raise KbError(f"{n.id} is not an idea")
    n.meta["status"] = "done"
    n.meta["updated"] = today()
    kb.save(n)
    return n

### `kb/kb/hooks.py`
~~~~~
"""Session lifecycle hooks: `kb hook session-start|stop|session-end` (stdin = hook JSON).

Hooks never fail a session: run() always returns 0 and logs exceptions to
<kb>/.state/hook-errors.log. No network, no LLM, never reads the transcript.
"""
import datetime
import json
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

CARD_CAP, HANDOFF_CAP, JOURNAL_CAP, TOTAL_CAP = 2500, 3000, 1500, 8000
SUMMARY_CAP = 500
FRICTION_HINT = ('If the user corrects you or a tool fails in a way worth remembering, '
                 'log it with: kb journal friction "<text>".')
EVENTS = ("session-start", "stop", "session-end")


def now():
    return datetime.datetime.now()


def cap(text, limit):
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    marker = "\n[...truncated]"
    return text[:max(0, limit - len(marker))] + marker


def git(cwd, *args):
    """Stdout of a git command, or None on failure."""
    try:
        r = subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=cwd, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
    except (OSError, subprocess.SubprocessError):
        return None
    return r.stdout.strip() if r.returncode == 0 else None


def one_line(s):
    return re.sub(r"\s+", " ", s or "").strip()


# ---- paths and state ---------------------------------------------------------

def ensure_state_root(kb_root):
    d = Path(kb_root) / ".state"
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    gi = d / ".gitignore"
    if not gi.exists():
        gi.write_text("*\n")
    return d


def state_dir(kb_root):
    d = ensure_state_root(kb_root) / "sessions"
    d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    return d


def state_path(kb_root, sid):
    return state_dir(kb_root) / (re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9_.-]", "_", sid) + ".json")


def load_state(p):
    try:
        return json.loads(Path(p).read_text())
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        return None


def save_state(p, st):
    tmp = Path(str(p) + ".tmp")
    tmp.write_text(json.dumps(st, ensure_ascii=False))
    os.replace(tmp, p)


STALE_DELETE_SECS = 2 * 86400   # SessionEnd never fired (crash, kill)
STALE_FRICTION_SECS = 12 * 3600


def prune_stale(kb_root):
    cutoff = time.time() - STALE_DELETE_SECS
    for p in state_dir(kb_root).glob("*.json"):
        try:
            if p.stat().st_mtime < cutoff:
                p.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass


def log_error(kb_root, event, exc):
    try:
        with open(ensure_state_root(kb_root) / "hook-errors.log", "a") as f:
            f.write(f"{now().isoformat(timespec='seconds')} {event} {type(exc).__name__}: {one_line(str(exc))}\n")
    except OSError:
        pass


# ---- journal -------------------------------------------------------------------

def journal_dir(kb_root):
    return Path(kb_root) / "journal"


def append_journal(kb_root, text, when=None):
    d = journal_dir(kb_root)
    d.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p = d / f"{(when or now()).date().isoformat()}.md"
    prefix = "\n" if p.exists() and p.stat().st_size else ""
    with open(p, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(prefix + text.rstrip("\n") + "\n")


def journal_records(kb_root):
    """All entries, oldest first, as (ts, project, text); ts is 'YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM' (minute
    resolution). Standalone `- friction (` lines are entries of their own."""
    out = []
    d = journal_dir(kb_root)
    for p in sorted(d.glob("*.md")) if d.is_dir() else []:
        day, cur = p.stem, None

        def flush():
            if cur:
                out.append((cur[0], cur[1], "\n".join(cur[2]).rstrip()))

        for line in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace").split("\n"):
            if line.startswith("## "):
                flush()
                parts = line[3:].split(" · ")
                m = re.match(r"(\d{4}-\d\d-\d\d) (\d\d:\d\d)", parts[0])
                ts = f"{m.group(1)}T{m.group(2)}" if m else f"{day}T00:00"
                cur = (ts, parts[1].strip() if len(parts) > 1 else "", [line])
            elif line.startswith("- friction ("):
                flush()
                m = re.match(r"- friction \((\d\d:\d\d)?[^,)]*, ([^)]*)\)", line)
                cur = (f"{day}T{m.group(1) or '00:00'}" if m else f"{day}T00:00",
                       m.group(2).strip() if m else "", [line])
            elif cur and line.strip():
                cur[2].append(line)
        flush()
    return out


def journal_entries(kb_root, project=None):
    """All entries, oldest first, as (project, text)."""
    out = [(p, t) for _, p, t in journal_records(kb_root)]
    if project is not None:
        out = [e for e in out if e[0] == project]
    return out


def tail(kb_root, project=None, n=5):
    es = journal_entries(kb_root, project)
    return [t for _, t in es[-n:]] if n > 0 else []


def add_friction(kb_root, text, cwd):
    """Attach to the newest live session whose cwd equals, contains or is inside `cwd`;
    else append a standalone line to today's journal. Returns a short description."""
    cwd = os.path.realpath(cwd)
    best, best_m = None, -1
    for p in state_dir(kb_root).glob("*.json"):
        if time.time() - p.stat().st_mtime > STALE_FRICTION_SECS:
            continue
        st = load_state(p)
        if not st or not st.get("cwd"):
            continue
        c = os.path.realpath(st["cwd"])
        rel = c == cwd or c.startswith(cwd.rstrip(os.sep) + os.sep) or cwd.startswith(c.rstrip(os.sep) + os.sep)
        m = p.stat().st_mtime_ns
        if rel and m > best_m:
            best, best_m = (p, st), m
    text = one_line(text)
    if best:
        p, st = best
        st.setdefault("friction", []).append(text)
        save_state(p, st)
        return f"friction noted for session {st.get('session_id', '')[:8]}"
    t = now()
    name = find_card_id(kb_root, cwd) or os.path.basename(cwd) or cwd
    append_journal(kb_root, f"- friction ({t:%H:%M}, {name}): {text}", t)
    return "friction written to journal"


# ---- project / task context --------------------------------------------------

def find_card(kb_root, cwd):
    from .store import Kb
    try:
        return Kb(kb_root).find_project(cwd)
    except Exception:
        return None


def find_card_id(kb_root, cwd):
    c = find_card(kb_root, cwd)
    return c.id if c else ""


def main_worktree(cwd):
    out = git(cwd, "worktree", "list", "--porcelain")
    if out:
        first = out.split("\n", 1)[0]
        if first.startswith("worktree "):
            return first[len("worktree "):]
    return None


STEP_RE = re.compile(r"^###\s+(.+?)\s+·\s+`([A-Za-z-]+)`", re.M)


def parse_tasks(root, all_=False):
    """Tasks of `<root>/.tasks/*/TASK.md` as dicts (title, status, branch, handoff, next,
    steps = [(name, status)]); done/parked are skipped unless all_. The one TASK.md parser."""
    res = []
    for p in sorted(Path(root).glob(".tasks/*/TASK.md")):
        try:
            text = p.read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")
        except OSError:
            continue
        sm = re.search(r"Status \(internal\):\s*([A-Za-z-]+)", text)
        status = sm.group(1).lower() if sm else ""
        if status in ("done", "parked") and not all_:
            continue
        bm = re.search(r"Branch:\s*([^\s·(]+)", text)
        tm = re.search(r"^#\s+(.+)$", text, re.M)
        hm = re.search(r"^## Handoff[^\n]*\n(.*?)(?=^## |\Z)", text, re.M | re.S)
        handoff = hm.group(0).strip() if hm else ""
        nm = re.search(r"\*\*Next:\*\*\s*(.*?)(?=\n- \*\*|\Z)", handoff, re.S)
        res.append({"title": tm.group(1).strip() if tm else p.parent.name, "status": status or "?",
                    "branch": bm.group(1) if bm else "", "handoff": handoff,
                    "next": one_line(nm.group(1)) if nm else "",
                    "steps": [(m.group(1), m.group(2).lower()) for m in STEP_RE.finditer(text)]})
    return res


def open_tasks(cwd):
    """[(title, status, branch, handoff_text)] of open tasks in the main worktree."""
    root = main_worktree(cwd)
    if not root:
        return []
    return [(t["title"], t["status"], t["branch"], t["handoff"]) for t in parse_tasks(root)]


# ---- events --------------------------------------------------------------------

def session_start(kb_root, data):
    cwd = data.get("cwd") or os.getcwd()
    sid = data.get("session_id") or ""
    in_git = git(cwd, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel") is not None
    card = find_card(kb_root, cwd)
    if not in_git and not card:
        return None
    branch = (git(cwd, "symbolic-ref", "--short", "-q", "HEAD") or "") if in_git else ""
    head = (git(cwd, "rev-parse", "HEAD") or "") if in_git else ""
    pid = card.id if card else ""
    if sid:
        p = state_path(kb_root, sid)
        prune_stale(kb_root)
        if not p.exists():
            save_state(p, {"session_id": sid, "cwd": cwd, "project": pid, "branch": branch,
                           "start_head": head, "git": in_git, "started_at": time.time(),
                           "turns": 0, "last_assistant_message": ""})
    if not card:
        hint = ("This git repo has no project card in the kb. "
                f'Register it with: kb project add <name> --path "{cwd}"')
        return {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": hint},
                "systemMessage": "pipeline: no project card for this repo (kb project add)"}
    parts = ["## Project card\n" + cap(card.text().strip(), CARD_CAP)]
    tasks = open_tasks(cwd) if in_git else []
    if tasks:
        full = [f"### {t} ({s}, this branch)\n{h}" for t, s, b, h in tasks if branch and b == branch and h]
        short = [f"- {t} ({s})" for t, s, b, h in tasks if not (branch and b == branch and h)]
        parts.append("## Open tasks\n" + cap("\n".join(full + short), HANDOFF_CAP))
    entries = tail(kb_root, pid, 5)
    if entries:
        parts.append("## Recent journal\n" + cap("\n\n".join(entries), JOURNAL_CAP))
    parts.append(FRICTION_HINT)
    ctx = cap("\n\n".join(parts), TOTAL_CAP)
    msg = (f"pipeline: {pid} · {len(tasks)} open task{'' if len(tasks) == 1 else 's'}"
           f" · {len(entries)} journal entr{'y' if len(entries) == 1 else 'ies'}")
    return {"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "SessionStart", "additionalContext": ctx},
            "systemMessage": msg}


def stop(kb_root, data):
    sid = data.get("session_id")
    if not sid:
        return None
    p = state_path(kb_root, sid)
    st = load_state(p)
    if st is None:
        return None
    st["turns"] = st.get("turns", 0) + 1
    st["last_assistant_message"] = (data.get("last_assistant_message") or "")[:SUMMARY_CAP]
    save_state(p, st)
    return None


def fmt_duration(sec):
    sec = int(max(0, sec))
    h, rem = divmod(sec, 3600)
    m, s = divmod(rem, 60)
    return f"{h}h{m:02d}m" if h else (f"{m}m{s:02d}s" if m else f"{s}s")


def cap_list(items, limit, sep):
    shown = items[:limit]
    more = len(items) - len(shown)
    return sep.join(shown) + (f" (+{more} more)" if more > 0 else "")


def session_end(kb_root, data):
    sid = data.get("session_id")
    if not sid:
        return None
    p = state_path(kb_root, sid)
    st = load_state(p)
    if st is None:
        return None
    try:
        if st.get("turns", 0) == 0 or not (st.get("git") or st.get("project")):
            return None
        cwd = st.get("cwd") or data.get("cwd") or ""
        start = st.get("start_head") or ""
        t = now()
        label = st.get("project") or os.path.basename(cwd.rstrip("/")) or cwd
        lines = [f"## {t:%Y-%m-%d %H:%M} · {label} · {st.get('branch') or '-'} · {sid[:8]}",
                 f"- cwd: {cwd}",
                 f"- reason: {data.get('reason', '')}",
                 f"- turns: {st.get('turns', 0)}",
                 f"- duration: {fmt_duration(time.time() - st.get('started_at', time.time()))}"]
        if st.get("git") and os.path.isdir(cwd):
            files = []
            for line in (git(cwd, "status", "--porcelain") or "").split("\n"):
                if len(line) > 3:
                    files.append(line[3:].split(" -> ")[-1].strip('"'))
            if start:
                files += (git(cwd, "diff", "--name-only", f"{start}..HEAD") or "").split("\n")
            files = list(dict.fromkeys(f for f in files if f))
            if files:
                lines.append(f"- changed: {cap_list(files, 10, ', ')}")
            if start:
                commits = [c for c in (git(cwd, "log", "--oneline", f"{start}..HEAD") or "").split("\n") if c]
                if commits:
                    lines.append(f"- commits: {cap_list(commits, 5, '; ')}")
        summary = one_line(st.get("last_assistant_message"))
        if summary:
            lines.append(f"- summary: {summary}")
        for f in st.get("friction", []):
            lines.append(f"- friction: {f}")
        append_journal(kb_root, "\n".join(lines), t)
    finally:
        try:
            p.unlink()
        except OSError:
            pass
    return None


HANDLERS = {"session-start": session_start, "stop": stop, "session-end": session_end}


def run(event, kb_flag=None, stdin=None):
    """Entry point for `kb hook <event>`. Always returns 0."""
    root = None
    try:
        root = Path(kb_flag or os.environ.get("KB_DIR") or "~/agent-kb").expanduser()
        if not root.is_dir():
            return 0
        raw = (stdin if stdin is not None else sys.stdin).read()
        data = json.loads(raw) if raw.strip() else {}
        if not isinstance(data, dict):
            data = {}
        out = HANDLERS[event](root, data)
        if out:
            print(json.dumps(out, ensure_ascii=False))
    except Exception as e:  # never fail a session
        if root is not None and root.is_dir():
            log_error(root, event, e)
    return 0

### `kb/kb/retro.py`
~~~~~
"""Deterministic half of the self-improvement loop: `kb retro gather|record`.

The judgment (what to change in which instruction file) lives in the /pipeline:retro skill.
"""
import datetime
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

from . import hooks
from .store import ID_RE, KbError

OUTPUT_CAP = 12000
FRICTION_CAP = 4000
MIN_FMT = "%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M"


def parse_iso(s):
    try:
        return datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s.strip())
    except (ValueError, AttributeError):
        raise KbError(f"not an ISO timestamp: {s!r} (e.g. 2026-10-29T14:30:00)")


def minute(s):
    """Normalise an ISO timestamp to the journal's minute resolution."""
    return parse_iso(s).strftime(MIN_FMT)


def last_until(kb):
    """Newest `until` among retro notes (minute resolution), or None."""
    best = None
    for p in kb.files():
        try:
            if "type: retro" not in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")[:2000]:
                continue
            n = kb.load_file(p)
        except (KbError, OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
            continue
        u = n.get("until")
        if n.get("type") == "retro" and u:
            try:
                m = minute(u)
            except KbError:
                continue
            if best is None or m > best:
                best = m
    return best


def scope_files(kb):
    """Instruction files in scope that exist (paths only)."""
    home = Path.home()
    cands = [home / ".claude" / "CLAUDE.md"]
    for card in sorted(kb.projects(), key=lambda n: n.id):
        raw = card.get("path")
        if not raw:
            continue
        pp = Path(raw).expanduser()
        slug = re.sub(r"[^A-Za-z0-9]", "-", str(pp))
        cands += [pp / "CLAUDE.md", home / ".claude" / "projects" / slug / "memory" / "MEMORY.md"]
    toolkit = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
    cands += sorted((toolkit / "plugin" / "skills").glob("*/SKILL.md"))
    cands += sorted((home / ".claude" / "skills").glob("*/SKILL.md"))
    out = []
    for c in cands:
        if c.is_file() and str(c) not in out:
            out.append(str(c))
    return out


def _friction_of(ts, project, text):
    """Verbatim friction texts of one journal record."""
    out = []
    for line in text.split("\n"):
        m = re.match(r"- friction(?: \([^)]*\))?: (.*)$", line)
        if m:
            out.append({"date": ts[:10], "project": project, "text": m.group(1)})
    return out


def gather(kb, since=None, project=None, now=None):
    now = now or datetime.datetime.now()
    if since:
        since_m, source = minute(since), "--since"
    else:
        since_m = last_until(kb)
        source = "last retro" if since_m else "none (no retro yet: everything)"
    # >= at minute resolution: an entry in the same minute as `until` may repeat, never get lost
    recs = [r for r in hooks.journal_records(kb.root)
            if (since_m is None or r[0] >= since_m) and (project is None or r[1] == project)]
    recs.reverse()  # newest first
    counts = {}
    for _, proj, _ in recs:
        counts[proj or "-"] = counts.get(proj or "-", 0) + 1
    friction = [f for ts, pr, tx in recs for f in _friction_of(ts, pr or "-", tx)]
    return {"gathered_at": now.strftime("%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S"), "since": since_m, "since_source": source,
            "project": project, "counts": counts, "friction": friction,
            "entries": [{"ts": ts, "project": pr, "text": tx} for ts, pr, tx in recs],
            "files": scope_files(kb)}


def _fit(items, render, budget):
    """Keep leading items while they fit; returns (rendered list, omitted count)."""
    out, used = [], 0
    for i, it in enumerate(items):
        r = render(it)
        if used + len(r) + 1 > budget:
            return out, len(items) - i
        out.append(r)
        used += len(r) + 1
    return out, 0


def render(g):
    """Text report, <= OUTPUT_CAP chars; says what was cut."""
    head = [f"gathered_at: {g['gathered_at']}",
            f"since: {g['since'] or '-'} ({g['since_source']})" + (f"  project: {g['project']}" if g["project"] else ""),
            f"entries: {len(g['entries'])}  " + ", ".join(f"{p}: {c}" for p, c in sorted(g["counts"].items()))]
    fr, fr_omit = _fit(g["friction"], lambda f: f"- {f['date']} {f['project']}: {f['text']}", FRICTION_CAP)
    head += [f"\n## Friction ({len(g['friction'])})"] + (fr or ["(none)"])
    if fr_omit:
        head.append(f"... {fr_omit} older friction lines omitted")
    tail = ["\n## Instruction files in scope (existing)"] + (g["files"] or ["(none)"])
    head_s, tail_s = "\n".join(head), "\n".join(tail)
    reserve = len("\n\n## Entries (newest first)\n... 99999 older entries omitted\n")
    budget = OUTPUT_CAP - len(head_s) - len(tail_s) - reserve
    shown, omit = _fit(g["entries"], lambda e: e["text"] + "\n", max(budget, 0))
    mid = ["\n## Entries (newest first)"] + ([("\n".join(shown)).rstrip("\n")] if shown else ["(none)"])
    if omit:
        mid.append(f"... {omit} older entries omitted")
    return head_s + "\n" + "\n".join(mid) + "\n" + tail_s + "\n"


def to_json(g):
    """JSON form with the same cap: older entries are dropped and counted."""
    out = dict(g)
    base = len(str(g["files"])) + len(str(g["friction"])) + 600
    shown, omit = _fit(g["entries"], lambda e: e["text"] + "\n", max(OUTPUT_CAP - base, 0))
    out["entries"] = g["entries"][:len(shown)]
    out["entries_omitted"] = omit
    return out


# ---- record -----------------------------------------------------------------

def _git(root, *args):
    return subprocess.run(["git", *args], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True)


def record(kb, until, accepted, rejected, body):
    when = parse_iso(until)
    d = when.date().isoformat()
    nid, n = f"retro-{d}", 1
    while (kb.notes_dir / f"{nid}.md").exists():
        n += 1
        nid = f"retro-{d}-{n}"
    assert ID_RE.match(nid)
    note = kb.create("retro", f"Retro {d}", nid=nid, body=body,
                     extra={"until": when.isoformat(timespec="seconds"),
                            "accepted": accepted, "rejected": rejected})
    return note, commit(kb, note, d)


def commit(kb, note, date):
    """Commit journal/ + the note in the kb repo (local only). Returns a status line."""
    root = kb.root
    top = _git(root, "rev-parse", "--show-toplevel")
    if top.returncode != 0 or Path(top.stdout.strip()).resolve() != root.resolve():
        return "kb is not a git repo: skipped commit"
    paths = [f"notes/{note.id}.md"] + (["journal"] if (root / "journal").is_dir() else [])
    r = _git(root, "add", "--", *paths)
    if r.returncode == 0:
        r = _git(root, "commit", "-q", "-m", f"retro {date}", "--", *paths)
    if r.returncode != 0:
        return f"commit failed: {(r.stderr or r.stdout).strip()}"
    return f"committed in kb: retro {date}"

### `kb/kb/store.py`
~~~~~
"""Note files, frontmatter, references and the search index."""
import datetime
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import sqlite3
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path

TYPES = ("note", "project", "idea", "decision", "howto", "retro")
STATUSES = ("active", "paused", "done")
BASE_FIELDS = ("id", "type", "title", "project", "tags", "refs", "status", "created", "updated")
PROJECT_FIELDS = ("path", "stack", "commands")
RETRO_FIELDS = ("until", "accepted", "rejected")  # type retro only
LIST_FIELDS = ("tags", "refs", "commands", "accepted", "rejected")
BLOCK_LISTS = ("commands",)  # written as `- item` lines; parsed either way
ID_RE = re.compile(r"^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$")
LINK_RE = re.compile(r"\[\[([^\[\]\n]+)\]\]")


class KbError(Exception):
    pass


# ---- ids -------------------------------------------------------------------

def slugify(text):
    return re.sub(r"[^a-z0-9]+", "-", text.lower()).strip("-")


def resolve_id(raw):
    """proj://name -> proj-name, kb://id -> id, anything else unchanged."""
    raw = raw.strip()
    if raw.startswith("proj://"):
        return "proj-" + raw[len("proj://"):]
    if raw.startswith("kb://"):
        return raw[len("kb://"):]
    return raw


# ---- frontmatter (restricted YAML subset) ----------------------------------
# key: value          scalar (double-quoted JSON string when it needs escaping)
# key: [a, b]         inline list
# key:                followed by `  - item` lines: block list
# Anything else between the `---` fences is a parse error.

def _scalar(s):
    s = s.strip()
    if s.startswith('"'):
        try:
            v = json.loads(s)
        except ValueError:
            raise KbError(f"bad quoted string: {s}")
        if not isinstance(v, str):
            raise KbError(f"bad quoted string: {s}")
        return v
    return s


def _split_inline(s):
    items, buf, quoted, esc = [], "", False, False
    for ch in s:
        if quoted:
            buf += ch
            if esc:
                esc = False
            elif ch == "\\":
                esc = True
            elif ch == '"':
                quoted = False
        elif ch == '"':
            quoted = True
            buf += ch
        elif ch == ",":
            items.append(buf)
            buf = ""
        else:
            buf += ch
    if quoted:
        raise KbError(f"unterminated quote in list: [{s}]")
    items.append(buf)
    return [_scalar(i) for i in items if i.strip()]


def _quote(s, inline=False, block=False):
    bad = s != s.strip() or not s or "\n" in s or s.startswith('"')
    if inline:
        bad = bad or any(c in s for c in ',[]"')
    elif not block:
        bad = bad or s.startswith("[")
    return json.dumps(s, ensure_ascii=False) if bad else s


def parse_frontmatter(text):
    """Return (meta dict, body). Raises KbError on anything malformed."""
    lines = text.split("\n")
    if lines[0].rstrip() != "---":
        raise KbError("no frontmatter (file must start with ---)")
    try:
        end = next(i for i in range(1, len(lines)) if lines[i].rstrip() == "---")
    except StopIteration:
        raise KbError("frontmatter is not closed with ---")
    meta, key = {}, None
    for n, line in enumerate(lines[1:end], 2):
        if not line.strip():
            continue
        m = re.match(r"^\s+-\s?(.*)$", line)
        if m:
            if key is None or not isinstance(meta[key], list):
                raise KbError(f"line {n}: list item without a list key")
            meta[key].append(_scalar(m.group(1)))
            continue
        m = re.match(r"^([A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*):(?:\s+(.*))?$", line.rstrip())
        if not m:
            raise KbError(f"line {n}: cannot parse: {line}")
        key, val = m.group(1), (m.group(2) or "").strip()
        if key in meta:
            raise KbError(f"line {n}: duplicate key {key}")
        if val.startswith("["):
            if not val.endswith("]"):
                raise KbError(f"line {n}: unterminated list")
            meta[key] = _split_inline(val[1:-1])
            key = None
        elif val == "" and key in LIST_FIELDS:
            meta[key] = []  # items may follow as a block
        else:
            meta[key] = _scalar(val)
            key = None
    for f in LIST_FIELDS:
        if f in meta and not isinstance(meta[f], list):
            meta[f] = [meta[f]] if meta[f] else []
    body = "\n".join(lines[end + 1:]).strip("\n")
    return meta, body


def format_note(meta, body):
    keys = [k for k in BASE_FIELDS + PROJECT_FIELDS + RETRO_FIELDS if k in meta]
    keys += [k for k in meta if k not in keys]
    out = ["---"]
    for k in keys:
        v = meta[k]
        if isinstance(v, list):
            if k in BLOCK_LISTS and v:
                out.append(f"{k}:")
                out += [f"  - {_quote(i, block=True)}" for i in v]
            else:
                out.append(f"{k}: [{', '.join(_quote(i, inline=True) for i in v)}]")
        else:
            v = str(v)
            out.append(f"{k}: {_quote(v)}" if v else f"{k}:")
    out.append("---")
    text = "\n".join(out) + "\n"
    body = body.strip("\n")
    return text + ("\n" + body + "\n" if body else "")


# ---- store -----------------------------------------------------------------

def today():
    return datetime.date.today().isoformat()


def find_kb(flag=None):
    kb = flag or os.environ.get("KB_DIR") or "~/agent-kb"
    kb = Path(kb).expanduser()
    if not kb.is_dir():
        raise KbError(f"kb directory not found: {kb} (set --kb or KB_DIR, or run install.sh)")
    return kb


class Note:
    def __init__(self, path, meta, body):
        self.path, self.meta, self.body = path, meta, body

    @property
    def id(self):
        return self.meta.get("id", "")

    def get(self, key, default=""):
        return self.meta.get(key, default)

    def refs(self):
        """Frontmatter refs plus body [[id]] links, normalised and de-duplicated."""
        out = []
        for r in list(self.meta.get("refs", [])) + LINK_RE.findall(self.body):
            r = resolve_id(r)
            if r and r not in out:
                out.append(r)
        return out

    def text(self):
        return format_note(self.meta, self.body)

    def to_dict(self):
        return {**self.meta, "body": self.body}


class Kb:
    def __init__(self, root):
        self.root = Path(root)
        self.notes_dir = self.root / "notes"

    def files(self):
        return sorted(self.notes_dir.glob("*.md")) if self.notes_dir.is_dir() else []

    def load_file(self, path):
        meta, body = parse_frontmatter(path.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
        return Note(path, meta, body)

    def load_all(self):
        """(notes, errors): errors is a list of (path, message)."""
        notes, errors = [], []
        for p in self.files():
            try:
                notes.append(self.load_file(p))
            except (KbError, UnicodeDecodeError, OSError) as e:
                errors.append((p, str(e)))
        return notes, errors

    def get(self, raw_id):
        nid = resolve_id(raw_id)
        p = self.notes_dir / f"{nid}.md"
        if not ID_RE.match(nid) or not p.is_file():
            raise KbError(f"no such note: {nid}")
        return self.load_file(p)

    def save(self, note, exclusive=False):
        self.notes_dir.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        tmp = note.path.with_name(f".{note.path.name}.tmp")
        tmp.write_text(note.text(), encoding="utf-8")
        if exclusive:
            try:
                os.link(tmp, note.path)  # fails if it exists
            except FileExistsError:
                raise KbError(f"note already exists: {note.id}")
            finally:
                tmp.unlink()
        else:
            os.replace(tmp, note.path)

    def create(self, type_, title, nid=None, project="", tags=(), refs=(), body="", extra=None):
        if type_ not in TYPES:
            raise KbError(f"unknown type '{type_}' (one of: {', '.join(TYPES)})")
        title = " ".join(title.split())
        if not title:
            raise KbError("title is empty")
        slug = slugify(title)
        nid = resolve_id(nid) if nid else ("proj-" + slug if type_ == "project" else slug)
        if not ID_RE.match(nid):
            raise KbError(f"invalid id '{nid}' (lowercase letters, digits, '-'; must not start with '-')")
        d = today()
        meta = {"id": nid, "type": type_, "title": title,
                "project": project or (slug if type_ == "project" else ""),
                "tags": list(tags), "refs": [resolve_id(r) for r in refs],
                "status": "", "created": d, "updated": d}
        if type_ == "project":
            meta.update({"status": "active", "path": "", "stack": "", "commands": []})
        for k, v in (extra or {}).items():
            if v not in (None, "", []):
                meta[k] = v
        note = Note(self.notes_dir / f"{nid}.md", meta, body)
        self.save(note, exclusive=True)
        return note

    def backlinks(self, nid, notes=None):
        notes = notes if notes is not None else self.load_all()[0]
        return [n for n in notes if nid in n.refs() and n.id != nid]

    # ---- projects ----------------------------------------------------------

    def projects(self):
        out = []
        for p in self.files():
            try:  # cheap pre-filter: skip files that cannot be project cards
                if "type: project" not in p.read_text(encoding="utf-8")[:2000]:
                    continue
                n = self.load_file(p)
            except (KbError, OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
                continue
            if n.get("type") == "project":
                out.append(n)
        return out

    def find_project(self, directory):
        """Card whose path is `directory` or an ancestor; longest path wins."""
        here = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(directory))
        best, best_len = None, -1
        for n in self.projects():
            raw = n.get("path")
            if not raw:
                continue
            p = os.path.realpath(os.path.expanduser(raw))
            if (here == p or here.startswith(p.rstrip(os.sep) + os.sep)) and len(p) > best_len:
                best, best_len = n, len(p)
        return best

    # ---- search ------------------------------------------------------------

    def _signature(self):
        parts = []
        for p in self.files():
            st = p.stat()
            parts.append(f"{p.name}:{st.st_mtime_ns}:{st.st_size}")
        return "\n".join(parts)

    def index(self, force=False):
        """Bring the FTS index up to date; returns an open connection."""
        d = self.root / ".index"
        d.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        db = sqlite3.connect(d / "kb.sqlite")
        sig = self._signature()
        try:
            db.execute("create table if not exists meta(k text primary key, v text)")
            row = db.execute("select v from meta where k='sig'").fetchone()
            if not force and row and row[0] == sig:
                return db
            db.execute("drop table if exists notes")
            db.execute("create virtual table notes using fts5("
                       "id unindexed, type unindexed, project unindexed, title, tags, body)")
            notes, _ = self.load_all()
            db.executemany("insert into notes values (?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                           [(n.id, n.get("type"), n.get("project"), n.get("title"),
                             " ".join(n.get("tags", [])), n.body) for n in notes])
            db.execute("insert or replace into meta values('sig', ?)", (sig,))
            db.commit()
        except sqlite3.Error:
            db.close()
            raise
        return db

    def search(self, query, type_=None, project=None, limit=10):
        tokens = re.findall(r"\w+", query.lower())
        if not tokens:
            raise KbError("empty search query")
        if not os.environ.get("KB_NO_FTS"):  # KB_NO_FTS=1 forces the rg path
            try:
                return self._search_fts(tokens, type_, project, limit)
            except sqlite3.Error:
                pass  # FTS5 unavailable or index unusable: fall back
        return self._search_rg(tokens, type_, project, limit)

    def _search_fts(self, tokens, type_, project, limit):
        db = self.index()
        try:
            q = " ".join(f'"{t}"*' for t in tokens)
            sql = ("select id, type, title, snippet(notes, -1, '[', ']', '...', 10) "
                   "from notes where notes match ?")
            args = [q]
            if type_:
                sql += " and type = ?"
                args.append(type_)
            if project:
                sql += " and project = ?"
                args.append(project)
            sql += " order by bm25(notes, 0, 0, 0, 10, 5, 1) limit ?"
            args.append(limit)
            return [{"id": i, "type": t, "title": ti, "snippet": " ".join(sn.split())}
                    for i, t, ti, sn in db.execute(sql, args)]
        finally:
            db.close()

    def _search_rg(self, tokens, type_, project, limit):
        if not shutil.which("rg"):
            raise KbError("search needs SQLite FTS5 or ripgrep (rg); neither is available")
        hits = None
        for t in tokens:  # AND semantics: files matching every token
            r = subprocess.run(["rg", "-il", "--fixed-strings", "-e", t, "--", str(self.notes_dir)],
                               capture_output=True, text=True)
            files = {Path(x) for x in r.stdout.splitlines()}
            hits = files if hits is None else hits & files
        scored = []
        for p in hits or ():
            try:
                n = self.load_file(p)
            except (KbError, OSError, UnicodeDecodeError):
                continue
            if (type_ and n.get("type") != type_) or (project and n.get("project") != project):
                continue
            title, tags, body = n.get("title").lower(), " ".join(n.get("tags", [])).lower(), n.body.lower()
            score = sum(10 * title.count(t) + 5 * tags.count(t) + body.count(t) for t in tokens)
            snippet = next((ln.strip() for ln in n.body.splitlines()
                            if any(t in ln.lower() for t in tokens)), n.body[:80])
            scored.append((-score, n.id, {"id": n.id, "type": n.get("type"),
                                          "title": n.get("title"), "snippet": " ".join(snippet.split())[:120]}))
        return [s[2] for s in sorted(scored, key=lambda s: s[:2])][:limit]

    # ---- check -------------------------------------------------------------

    def check(self):
        problems = []
        notes, errors = self.load_all()
        problems += [f"{p.name}: unparseable frontmatter: {m}" for p, m in errors]
        seen = {}
        for n in notes:
            for f in ("id", "type", "title"):
                if not n.get(f):
                    problems.append(f"{n.path.name}: missing required field '{f}'")
            if n.get("type") and n.get("type") not in TYPES:
                problems.append(f"{n.path.name}: unknown type '{n.get('type')}'")
            if n.id and n.id != n.path.stem:
                problems.append(f"{n.path.name}: id '{n.id}' does not match filename")
            elif n.id and not ID_RE.match(n.id):
                problems.append(f"{n.path.name}: invalid id '{n.id}'")
            seen.setdefault(n.id, []).append(n.path.name)
        for nid, names in seen.items():
            if nid and len(names) > 1:
                problems.append(f"duplicate id '{nid}' in {', '.join(names)}")
        for n in notes:
            for r in n.refs():
                if r not in seen:
                    problems.append(f"{n.path.name}: dangling ref '{r}'")
        return problems, len(notes)

### `plugin/hooks/run-kb.sh` · executable
~~~~~
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Runs `kb <args>` for a plugin hook. Exits 0 silently if kb is unavailable:
# hooks must never break a session.
if command -v kb >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  kb "$@"
elif [ -x "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}/../bin/kb" ]; then
  "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/../bin/kb" "$@"
fi
exit 0
~~~~~

### `plugin/skills/kb/SKILL.md`
~~~~~
---
name: kb
description: Read and write the personal knowledge base with the `kb` CLI (markdown notes in ~/agent-kb). Use at the start of unfamiliar work, before re-researching a fact, when the user mentions proj:// or kb:// ids, and to save durable facts, decisions and how-tos.
---

# Knowledge base (`kb`)

The kb is plain markdown notes, shared across all projects and sessions. The CLI is `kb`
(location: `--kb PATH` > `$KB_DIR` > `~/agent-kb`).

## Hard rule: local only

The kb is private. Never add a git remote to it, never push it, and never send its contents
to an external service (web tools, APIs, paste sites, remote models). Reading it into this session is fine.

## When to read

- At the start of unfamiliar work in a project: `kb project find` (card for the current directory), then search.
- Before re-researching a fact, a tool quirk or a past decision: search first.
- Whenever the user writes `proj://<name>` (= note `proj-<name>`) or `kb://<id>`: read that note.

```bash
kb search "sqlite wal" --type howto      # ranked hits: id, type, title, snippet
kb read proj://myapp --refs              # note + referenced notes + backlinks
kb project find                          # project card for the cwd (exit 1 if none)
kb project list
```

## When to write

Write only durable, reusable knowledge: a verified fact, a decision with its reason, a repeatable
how-to, a project card. Do not write session chatter, guesses, secrets or credentials.
Search first to avoid duplicates; link related notes.

Types: `note`, `project`, `idea`, `decision`, `howto` (and `retro`, written only by `kb retro record`).

```bash
kb new howto "Rebuild the search index" --project myapp --tags search,sqlite --body "Run kb index ..."
kb new decision "Use FTS5 over vectors" --refs proj://myapp --body - <<'EOF'
Why: keyword search is enough for now. Revisit if recall is poor.
EOF
kb link kb://rebuild-the-search-index proj://myapp   # add a ref (idempotent)
kb project add myapp --path ~/code/myapp --stack "python" --commands "make test" --status active
kb check                                             # validate; run after bulk edits
```

## Backlog and ideas

```bash
kb backlog [--project P] [--all] [--json]   # per registered project: open tasks (next step, handoff Next), open ideas; unfiled ideas; inbox count
kb idea add "text" [--project P] [--tags a,b]   # capture an idea (default project: card for the cwd); prints the id
kb idea done <id>                           # mark it done
```

## Session journal and friction

Hooks track each session (start, turns, last reply) and append one entry to
`<kb>/journal/YYYY-MM-DD.md` when it ends; SessionStart injects the project card, open task
handoffs and recent journal entries. You do not write those entries.

Log friction as it happens, one line, when the user corrects you or rejects your approach,
a tool or command fails unexpectedly, or you hit a repeated papercut worth fixing later:

```bash
kb journal friction "tests need KB_DIR unset or they touch the real kb"
kb journal tail --project proj-name -n 5     # recent entries, newest last
```

The note attaches to the live session (newest whose cwd equals, contains or is inside the
current dir) and lands in its journal entry; with no live session it becomes a standalone line.
The journal is local-only like the rest of the kb: it is never pushed or sent anywhere.

The user can turn the journal into instruction fixes with `/pipeline:retro` (backed by `kb retro gather|record`); do not run it unasked.

## Note format

`notes/<id>.md`: frontmatter between `---` lines (`id, type, title, project, tags, refs, status,
created, updated`; project cards add `path, stack, commands`), then a markdown body. Link other
notes in the body with `[[id]]`. ids are lowercase slugs. Edit notes with `kb` or directly;
`kb check` reports broken ones.
~~~~~

### `plugin/skills/retro/SKILL.md`
~~~~~
---
name: retro
description: Self-improvement retro. Reads the session journal and friction notes since the last retro and proposes small edits to instruction files (CLAUDE.md, memory, skills) for the user to approve. Run only when the user asks.
disable-model-invocation: true
---

# Retro

Turn recent friction into small, approved instruction fixes. The kb is local only: never push it,
never send its contents to an external service.

## Rules

- Edit nothing before the user approves. The only file you may write before approval is the proposals file in `<kb>/inbox/`.
- A proposal needs at least 2 journal occurrences (entries or friction lines) or one explicit user correction. No evidence, no proposal.
- Prefer deleting or tightening an instruction over adding one. Never add a rule that duplicates an existing one.
- At most 5 proposals. Fewer is fine.

## Steps

1. Run `kb retro gather` (add `--project <card id>` to narrow, `--since ISO` to override). Note its `gathered_at`: it becomes `--until` in step 6.
2. If it reports `entries: 0`, say "Nothing new in the journal since the last retro" and stop. Do not record anything.
3. Group the friction lines and entries by recurring theme. Read only the instruction files from the "in scope" list that a theme points at; do not read the rest.
4. Write the proposals to `<kb>/inbox/retro-<date>.md` (`<kb>` = `$KB_DIR` or `~/agent-kb`). Each proposal:
   - Number them `P1`..`P5` with a short title, e.g. `P1: drop stale test hint`.
   - **Target:** absolute path of one file
   - **Evidence:** the journal entries or friction lines cited by date + project (a user correction counts alone)
   - **Why:** one or two sentences
   - **Diff:** unified diff, minimal
5. Show the proposals (target, evidence, why, diff) and ask which to accept with AskUserQuestion (`multiSelect: true`, one option per proposal, label `P<n>: <title>`; AskUserQuestion allows at most 4 options per question, so with 5 proposals split them over two multiSelect questions). Apply only the accepted ones with Edit. Skip any whose target changed so the diff no longer applies, and say so.
6. Record the outcome. Put the proposals (with their titles) and the diffs of accepted ones in a body file; `--accepted`/`--rejected` take only the comma-separated numbers, since titles may contain commas, then:

   ```bash
   kb retro record --until <gathered_at> --accepted "P1,P3" --rejected "P2" --body-file <file>
   ```

   This writes `notes/retro-<date>.md` and commits `journal/` and that note in the kb repo (local commit only). The next `kb retro gather` starts at `--until`.
7. Report what was applied, what was rejected, and the retro note id.
~~~~~
